seo.title: IRATA & BNSP Rope Access Training in Indonesia · RAC
seo.description: RAC rope access training programmes: IRATA Levels 1, 2, and 3, BNSP TKPK certification, refreshers, and in-house training at your own site.

hero.title: Training That Prepares You for the Job, Not Just the Exam
hero.body: A maximum 1:6 instructor ratio, all PPE supplied, and assessment by an independent body. From zero experience to supervisor.

sections.title: Choose a training programme
sections.intro: Every programme below includes instructors, all personal protective equipment, use of the training facility, course materials, and assessment fees. You need only bring safety boots.

sections.title: Need a dedicated cohort for your team?
sections.text: For six participants or more, we can open a course on dates you choose — at our training centre or at your site.
